description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1705/18 of 10.05.2011 and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcel information including owner name changes, extent modifications, parcel number corrections, and leaseholder insertions for various land parcels across different districts. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
